notes.title: Yoku receives FOUR Develop:Star Awards nominations!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27885141/4c2052af207c3ad2d58ebd51c7c78444f7454fb6.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone

Yoku and its development team have just received a massive FOUR award nominations at this year's Develop:Star Awards!

[b]Yoku's Island Express[/b] has been nominated for:
[list]
[*] Best Visual Art
[*] Best Game Design
[*] Best Original IP
[/list]

Developer [b]Villa Gorilla[/b] received a nomination too, for:
[list]
[*] Best Micro Studio
[/list]

We're incredibly excited and proud of Villa Gorilla for having created such a special game and an experience we won't soon forget. Please help us in crossing fingers and toes for Yoku and Villa Gorilla when the award show takes place on July 10th!

You can learn more about Develop: Star Awards [url=https://developstarawards.awardstage.com/]here[/url]

[h1]Yet to try Yoku's Island Express?[/h1]
If you're just browsing this page and are wondering what all the fuss is about, we highly encourage you to check out the free demo right here on Steam - or on PS4, Xbox One or Nintendo Switch. We know you'll have a ball!

notes.title: Vote for Yoku at The Game Awards!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27885141/e78552ed1ebcc1db64ba6f8674eb2b0859e48f69.png[/img]

Hey everyone

Today we're extremely excited to share that [b]Yoku's Island Express[/b] has been nominated for [b]Best Debut Indie Game[/b] at this year's [b]The Game Awards[/b]!

With this nomination, [b]Yoku's Island Express and the development team at Villa Gorilla need your help[/b]. If you love Yoku as much as we do and think it deserves to win this highly competitive category, head on over to The Game Awards' website and cast your vote!

[url=https://thegameawards.com/awards/]>> VOTE HERE <<[/url]

Note that you can vote once every 24 hours until The Game Awards airs on December 6th. Sharing your vote on social media (via the website) increases the weight of each vote, so if you'd like to give Yoku the best possible chance to win, please do share wherever you can.

Your support means the world to the team. Thank you!

[h1]Check out the demo![/h1]
If you haven't played Yoku's Island Express yet, we encourage you to check out the free demo over [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/334940/Yokus_Island_Express/]on the store page[/url]. The demo is available on consoles too, if you'd rather play it there. In any case, have fun!

notes.title: Update 2 now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27885141/f43b58656fbe81e3912e514cdfd27aac0afa47c5.gif[/img]
Hi everyone!

Since the launch of Yoku’s Island Express, our fantastic community has been very helpful by informing us of any glitches they’ve found or areas where user friendly improvements could be made. 

So we’re happy to say that we’ve been working hard behind the scenes and have now released an update with a considerable number of improvements. Please see below for a full list of changes and be sure to let us know of any further feedback you have here on Steam or on our official social media accounts!

Quality of life improvements for Update 2:

•	Unopened chests and filled mailboxes are now visible regardless of a player’s location.
•	Scarab trackers are now displayed on the map when you get to 10 Scarabs or less.
•	Map marker for “Return to Nim” added after finding all three chiefs.

Bug fixes for Update 2:

•	Open chests and filled mailboxes are no longer visible on the map.
•	Fix for quest marker for “Ask Tunguska about getting some Climbing Gear” now disappears when criteria has been met.
•	Fix for shop marker missing on map for the Marrow Hill, Hideout Wickerling tracker.
•	Background no longer appears at low quality textures if the inventory is opened whilst zooming out of a telescope.
•	Map graphics no longer disappear when viewing the map immediately after leaving the Aerial Ascent telescope.
•	Fosfor no longer re-appears in their lair if returning after saving and reloading.
•	Music is now present in the pinball puzzle after approaching area from the Great Falls.
•	It is no longer possible to block yourself in the Peak area.
•	The camera no longer detaches from Yoku if using the Sootling on a Leash to fling Yoku off the edge in the Cove Mushroom location.
•	Fix for typo in one of Chirp’s lines of dialogue.
•	Graphical seam fixed when using the telescope near the bottom of the Great Falls.
•	Sumoe shop marker is now removed if the treasure map is purchased through the discounted option.
•	Fix for performance FPS drop if fruit isn’t collected from the Scarab in Everfrost Forest, The Lighthouse.
•	It is no longer possible for Yoku to get stuck within the Screetch.
•	Omh and Tilo no longer move location if you enter or leave Ivory Peaks Trail without talking to Jamja.
•	Particle effect from Seed Pod Branch is now removed after it has been picked up.
•	Lighting no longer pops at the top of the Tall Totem Tower reveal cutscene.
•	Fix for performance FPS drop during the Tall Totem Tower reveal cutscene.
•	It is no longer possible to knock the drop-down plank the wrong way in the Church of the Space Monks, Secret Sanctuary area.
•	Improvements to the Simplified Chinese localisation.

notes.title: Your feedback needed – New Chinese script
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Since the launch of Yoku’s Island Express, we’ve received a small amount of feedback to suggest that some players are unhappy with parts of the Chinese localisation of the game’s script.
We’re very sorry about this and are investigating the matter internally at Team17. As a first step to improve the quality we’ve made some changes to the Chinese script and uploaded a new version of the game to separate test branch.

[b]Access the Beta[/b]
[list]
[*]Open Steam, right-click Yoku's Island Express and select Properties
[*]Select Beta
[*]Enter the code "yokusnotjustanybug"
[*]Select [customersupport] via the drop-down menu
[/list]

It would help us very much if you can play the test translation and then leave a comment here or contact us at https://www.team17.com/support/ to tell us how happy you are with the improvements made to the script. If you are generally happy with the improvements then we will add them to the public Steam and console versions of the game as soon as possible.
Thanks for playing!

Team17
